description: Hi, my name is Divya. I take interest in AI, ML and data analysis. I like to build solutions that solve problems in an interesting yet easy way.
summary: In space, it becomes the responsibility of the astronauts to monitor their health. However, amidst the mission responsibilities, this can become a challenging task. Therefore, our team developed a full stack website which helps astronauts monitor their health based on certain physiological and behavioural benchmarks to help them determine which vitals they need to care of.
details:
Our project is a full stack website development that enables astronauts to monitor their health metrics through visualisation of charts and models, comparison of health trends and reports, and receive alerts when the vitals surpass the safety criteria.

The project has many benefits. It is smooth to navigate and easy to understand. The theme is relatable and engaging, combined with diverse features such as the Crew Overview, Cognitive Reaction Test and Mission Control dashboard.

We used: Frontend developments :

React.js

Vite

Js ( esp6+ )

Html5 and css3

Backend development :

Node.js

Express.js

Data base :

Mongodb

Mongoose

Ai and data processing:

Gemini API – AI integration.

Chart.js – Health data visualization.

csv-parse – CSV processing.

Framer Motion – UI animation

Our project hides away the complex building under an interactive interface. Inspired from the psychometric vital test, it features a small game that helps astronauts track their reaction time.

Our team considered the factors such as easiness in navigation, fast responsiveness, visual engagement as some of the factors.
